start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Forty Days
start.text:

The desert is silent.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Endure
curse_consequence.text:

Kneel in trust.

leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] This trial must be faced.
Return to prayer.

bread.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A voice whispers:
"Turn these stones into bread."

Speak the truth.

pinnacle.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He sets you on the temple.
"Throw yourself down. Angels will catch you."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] "Do not put God to the test."

leap_consequence.text:

Answer with truth.

boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Trust does not need proof.
Speak the word.

kingdoms.title: [TODO:pt-BR] All the Kingdoms
kingdoms.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He shows the world below.
"Bow to me and all is yours."

bow_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Serve God Alone
bow_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] No throne is worth your soul.
Speak the truth.

bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Truth has no price.
Stand firm.

departs.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The tempter fades into the dust.
Silence returns.

chase_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The battle is finished.
Rest in the Father.

rest.text:

The truth has prevailed.
